Only `FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` exists under the `*AgentTest.java` pattern, and all 29 tests pass.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering: basic/pattern formatting, time-zone-aware `format(Calendar/Date/long/Object)` dispatch and its unsupported-type error, pattern parsing edge cases (literals, escaped quotes, two-digit/padded/unpadded fields, 12/24-hour wraparound, day-in-week, era, negative proleptic week-year, ISO-8601 and `Z` time-zone variants, invalid pattern letters), `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, defensive-copy of `getTimeZone()`, null-argument constructor behavior, and serialization round-trip.
